semantic_checks: The exponent set is the actual finite set of nonnegative integer four-tuples whose sum equals k, represented by Finset.finsuppAntidiag univ k.
Both ordinary coordinate-sum and literal Finsupp-sum membership equivalences are proved.
The cardinality is exactly choose(k+3,k), and the uniform upper bound 4^k uses an applicable pinned combinatorial theorem. At k=0 the cardinality is exactly 1.
The actual MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous hypothesis forces every nonzero coefficient exponent to have total degree k; this is used to prove support containment rather than assumed as another premise.
The coefficient norm is the literal coefficient L1 norm from the prior reviewed modules. Support cardinality and the explicit per-coefficient bound C imply L1(P) <= 4^k*C.

The C nonnegativity hypothesis permits multiplication of the support-cardinality bound. The geometric corollary uses M>=0 and B>=0 to establish C=M*B^k>=0, and its exact conclusion is L1(P)<=M*(4*B)^k.
The zero polynomial and k=0 remain covered without a nonzero-polynomial hypothesis or an invalid equality between homogeneous degree and totalDegree.
Expanded statements have exactly the advertised physical-independent polynomial inputs and explicit coefficient bounds; there is no hidden conclusion or unbound counting proxy.
